title: DBP + selected triplet terms in the low-complexity range
question: Do a few strongest triplet terms added to the tuned DBP improve it at 600-2 500 RM, beyond triplets alone?
git_commit: recorded per run in results/runs/*.json (field git_commit); rule commit: see LOG.md
eval_rule: validation and (report-only) test every max(500, steps/40) steps; selection only by validation
model: triplets_ext.DBPTriplets: y = PhysDBP_Ns(x) + sum over the K strongest T3 terms C_j T_j(x), C = 0 at start
selection: stage select: closed-form T3 + FIR7 (M = 15) on all 30 train files, lambda by validation; terms ranked by |C| * rms(feature) -> results/terms.npz

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.adds_to_dbp: K triplets add to the DBP if (DBP + K) - DBP alone (same Ns, same recipe) >= 1 p.p., intervals do not overlap
rule_draft.beats_triplets: DBP + K beats triplets alone (E031/E034, best by validation with RM <= its RM) by >= 0.1 dB, non-overlapping intervals
